pages.text: A blank mimic can hold the pattern of matter taking shape. $(l)Right-click to open it.$() Place a reference at the center, then the required clues around it. The reference remains; the surrounding materials are used to shape the mimic.$(br2)The following entries describe each pattern. JEI shows their combinations.

pages.title: Matter from Aether
pages.text: Keep a shaped mimic in your pack. Spells use real materials first; when they are missing, the matching mimic creates them for an extra aether cost.$(br2)You can also use the mimic directly to place its material. $(l)Aether is spent, but the mimic remains.$()
